title: Controlled local KSU fan release record, schema 1
description: Caller-supplied, user-editable release decision. This is NOT a signature, attestation, evidence authentication system or independent proof that a KO loaded. The caller must actually review complete template scripts, provenance, genuine kernel build output, compatibility checks and actual target-device loading before issuing this record. Hashes bind the specific bytes and declaration only. No sample passing record is supplied. Missing/failed records or reports block release; --inspect emits diagnostics only and also returns nonzero while release is blocked. There is no validation-only or unsigned ZIP option.

compatibility_sha256.description: SHA-256 of canonical compatibility input: json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False) plus one LF, encoded UTF-8. Binds exact APK/KO hashes, device fields, expected kernel/CRCs and all template hashes. --inspect reports this digest after structural/APK audit succeeds, even if release evidence is missing. For preinit-replace this also binds strategy, pinned stock hash/target, replacement hash, exact helper hash, enabled-manifest input digest and the exact preinit action/template.

template_review.description: A local review assertion tied to the complete compatibility/template digest, not verified reviewer identity. No-op/placeholder screening is only a guardrail and cannot replace script review.

reports.description: Three distinct existing nonempty UTF-8 reports supplied explicitly via --build-report, --check-report and --load-report, each <=4 MiB with at least 32 non-whitespace characters and no placeholder markers. The caller must review their contents; the builder checks file hashes, distinctness and local pass decisions, not report truth. Device-load report must refer to actual target-device loading of these bytes, not synthetic/host tests or build success. No record/report is generated automatically. Replacement reports must cover the actual full oplus_fan replacement, preserved protections and approved preinit helper/lifecycle; metadata free-space and first-load installation must be checked by the responsible caller, not inferred from offline hashes.

preinit_helper.description: REQUIRED by the builder only for preinit-replace; forbidden for additive. Exact digest fields must equal compatibility.preinit. A local helper-review assertion, NOT authentication. The same separately hashed build/check/device_load reports and compatibility digest must cover this helper, enabled immutable manifest and full replacement. The builder does not treat editable pass decisions as device proof.
